scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n server,client "npm run dev:server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.build: npm run typecheck && npm run build -w client && CGO_ENABLED=0 go build -trimpath -o bin/server ./server/cmd/server
scripts.dev:server: go build -o bin/server ./server/cmd/server && cd server && PORT=3000 DRIFTWAKE_DEV=1 exec ../bin/server
scripts.lint: biome check . && test -z "$(gofmt -l content server)" && go vet ./...
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test
